### Environment
```{r setup}

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,  
  eval = TRUE, 
  tidy = TRUE
)

knitr::opts_knit$set(
  root.dir = "../"
)


# Environment Set up
rm(list = ls()) #Clean workspace
cat("\014")     #Clean Console
gc() # Free memory

# pipeline variables
long.compute <- TRUE
do.plot <- TRUE

# Establish working directory
library("rstudioapi")

# Set working directory to source file location
if (!requireNamespace("here", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("here")
setwd(here::here())   # project root; works in RStudio, knitr and Rscript

# Create output directories & load custom functions & colour scheme
source("scripts/Setup.R", local = knitr::knit_global())

```



## Loading dataset {.tabset}

### load dataset
```{r load_dataset}

TICAtlas <- LoadSeuratRds("data/TICAtlas.rds")

TICAtlas # 92,256 features across 317,111 cells (RNA assay)

head(TICAtlas@meta.data)

# set object defaults 
DefaultAssay(TICAtlas) <- "RNA"
Idents(TICAtlas) <- TICAtlas@meta.data$subtype


```

### Broad vis of dataset
```{r broad_dataset_vis}

 
output.dir <- "results/Broad_vis/"
if(!dir.exists(output.dir)){
  dir.create(output.dir, 
             recursive = T)}



library(ggplot2)

# get stats
head(TICAtlas@meta.data)

# gender
x <- TICAtlas@meta.data$gender
table(x)
length(unique(x))
# 4 levels \ male, female, unknown, and NA

# Source
x <- TICAtlas@meta.data$source
table(x)
length(unique(x))
# 13 levels

# subtype
x <- TICAtlas@meta.data$subtype
table(x)
length(unique(x))
# 13 levels

# cluster_kmeans_k6
x <- TICAtlas@meta.data$cluster_kmeans_k6
table(x)
length(unique(x))
# 7 levels

# cell_type
x <- TICAtlas@meta.data$cell_type
table(x)
length(unique(x))
# 25 levels

# patient
x <- TICAtlas@meta.data$patient
table(x)
length(unique(x))
# 181 levels


# plot metadata variables on umap projection

vars.plot <- c("gender", "source", "subtype", "cluster_kmeans_k6", "cell_type")

for(i in seq_along(vars.plot)){
  
  print(scCustomize::DimPlot_scCustom(TICAtlas, 
                                      reduction = "umap", 
                                      group.by = vars.plot[i], 
                                      pt.size = 1,
                                      label = TRUE,
                                      figure_plot = TRUE)
  )
  
  
  dev.copy(pdf, paste0(output.dir, "UMAP_TICAtlas_dataset_grouped_by_", vars.plot[i], ".pdf"))
  dev.off()
  
}

# inspect how source and subtype definitions differ
x <- TICAtlas@meta.data$source
y <- TICAtlas@meta.data$subtype
table(x, y)
  
  


```
